reference.catalog.note: The data are Heat Pump KEYMARK certification test results (EN 14511, EN 14825) collected and processed by the hplib project (Forschungszentrum Jülich / RE-Lab, MIT licence). For every model the certified SCOP, ηs, outputs, sound power levels and the coefficients of the COP and electrical power regression model are available. The model accuracy is checked by an automated test: the SCOP reproduced per EN 14825 matches the certified value (median error ≈ 4 %).
reference.climate.note: Reference climate parameters of the regional centres (DSTU-N B V.1.1-27:2010). The temperature zone follows from the degree-days at θi = 20 °C (DBN V.2.6-31:2016). Verify the values against the current standard before use in design documentation.
reference.method.text:
• U-values — EN ISO 6946; slab on ground — EN ISO 13370 (including periodic heat transfer).
• Design heat load — EN 12831 (simplified thermal bridge surcharge ΔU, infiltration from n50).
• Annual demand — bin method over the distribution of outdoor temperature hours, gain utilisation factor — EN ISO 13790.
• Heat pump — hplib model, heating curve from the emitter characteristic (EN 442), part load and cycling — EN 14825 (Cd = 0.9), back-up heater below the operation limit.
• Domestic hot water — Q = N·V·365·c·Δθ·(1 + f_losses).
reference.negative: Price and CO₂ factor cannot be negative.
